text: {"432":{"about":["rustc_expand"],"refers":[],"why":"The macro-expansion driver detects lack of progress and turns it into a compilation error."},"433":{"about":["rustc_expand"],"refers":[],"why":"The unresolved-macro queue is maintained by the macro-expansion algorithm."},"434":{"about":["rustc_expand","rustc_resolve"],"refers":[],"why":"Macro expansion collects and processes invocations, while name resolution resolves imports and macro names."},"435":{"about":["rustc_expand","rustc_resolve"],"refers":[],"why":"The expansion loop handles resolved and unresolved invocations, relying on resolution and reporting failure when no progress is possible."},"436":{"about":["rustc_expand"],"refers":[],"why":"Macro expansion recovers from unresolved invocations by continuing with error expansions to enable diagnostics."}}
